result.title: k-Volume: a Unified Active Learning Strategy
result.summary: In the classification context where revealing the label of a sample is costly, we propose a new Active Learning (AL) strategy named k-Volume (kVol). It randomly selects a sample to be labeled according to the volume of the smallest ball containing its k nearest neighbors. kVol is highly versatile: it can be applied either in the input space or in the output space, and it enjoys the desirable properties of the three main families of AL strategies: density, diversity, and (when performed in the output space) uncertainty. From a theoretical perspective, we establish that kVol is asymptotically equivalent to uniform sampling over the support of the (input or output) data distribution. Based on experiments on various synthetic and real-life tabular datasets and images, we observe that kVol is surprisingly stable: whatever the classifier or the experimental setup, it still lies among the best AL strategies unlike other competitors that fail dramatically. In particular, kVol outperforms state-of-the-art competitors such as CoreSet, TypiClust or Uncertainty on several real-life datasets, at a low computational cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 k-Volume（kVol）主动学习策略：按包含某样本 k 个最近邻的最小球的体积进行随机抽样标注，可在输入空间或输出空间使用，兼具密度、多样性与（输出空间下）不确定性性质，并在理论上渐近等价于在数据支撑集上均匀采样；在合成/真实表格数据与图像上验证其稳定性与较低计算成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 以邻居球体积作为「信息量/覆盖度」的几何代理，可能为 LVR 中「看哪里」的证据筛选、查询或记忆选择提供可核查的启发式，但其面向训练期标注、高维表示空间中的行为仍需进一步判断。
